en.headline: Hong Kong joins global drug standards body as regulatory member
en.dek: The Health Bureau said Hong Kong became the 20th regulatory member of the ICH after approval at a Czech Republic assembly on 17 November.
body: Hong Kong, China has formally joined the International Council for Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Pharmaceuticals for Human Use as a regulatory member, the Health Bureau announced on Friday.

The ICH approved the admission of Hong Kong, represented by the Pharmacy and Poisons Board of Hong Kong, as its 20th regulatory member at an assembly meeting in the Czech Republic on 17 November. Other regulatory members include the National Medical Products Administration of China and authorities from Europe, Switzerland, the United Kingdom and the United States.

The bureau said the membership signifies international recognition of the city's drug research and development and regulatory standards. It will support development of primary evaluation capabilities for innovative drugs and allow Hong Kong to participate in shaping international rules on drug R&D and registration.

Secretary for Health Lo Chung-mau said the government thanked the country for its support in developing Hong Kong into an international health and medical innovation hub. He noted that Hong Kong became an ICH observer on 31 October 2023 and fulfilled all requirements to become a regulatory member in three years, faster than the eight to 10 years previously estimated.
The government plans to set up a centre for medical products regulation to build independent drug evaluation capacity.

zh.headline: 香港正式加入國際人用藥品註冊技術協調會成為監管成員
zh.dek: 醫務衛生局表示，香港在11月17日捷克大會上獲接納為ICH第20個監管機構成員。
body: 醫務衛生局周五宣布，中國香港已正式加入「國際人用藥品註冊技術協調會」（ICH），成為監管機構成員。
ICH在11月17日於捷克舉行的大會上，通過由香港藥劑業及毒藥管理局代表的中國香港成為第20個監管機構成員。其他監管機構成員包括中國國家藥品監督管理局，以及歐洲、瑞士、英國和美國等地的監管機構。
局方表示，此舉代表香港藥物研發及監管水平獲國際認可，有助進一步發展創新藥物「主要評估」能力及機制，並讓香港深度參與制定藥品研發和註冊的國際規則，加速發展成為國際健康及醫療創新樞紐。
醫務衛生局局長盧寵茂表示，特區政府感謝國家支持香港發展成為國際健康及醫療創新樞紐。他指出，香港自2023年10月31日成為ICH觀察員後，僅用三年時間已滿足所有要求正式成為監管成員，遠快於早前參考國際經驗估計的八至十年。
政府計劃成立藥物及醫療器械監督管理中心，建立獨立藥物評估及審批能力。
